## Source
.design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md — REQ-7, AC-5 + decomposition PR 5.

## Surface
- `polaris-ozone-import/src/verify.rs`
- New subcommand: `polaris-ozone-import verify --source <dump> --target <db>`
- Reports per-table row counts and per-table SHA-256 over a deterministic sample of fields.

## Rust-quality notes
- The deterministic sample is `ORDER BY id LIMIT 10000` per source table — guarantees identical sample selection on source and target.
- SHA-256 via `sha2` crate (workspace dep verify before adding).
- Per rust-quality §3: verify subcommand returns `Result<VerifyReport, VerifyError>`; the main reports `VerifyReport::has_discrepancies()` as the exit code.
- The report struct is `Serialize`-derived so `--format json` outputs machine-readable for CI/ops scripting.
- Per rust-quality §7: integration test deliberately tampers a row in the target post-import; verify subcommand catches it.

## External references
- sha2 crate: https://docs.rs/sha2/latest/sha2/
- Deterministic ordering in Postgres: ORDER BY id is stable iff id is monotonically inserted

## Acceptance (AC-5)
- [ ] `polaris-ozone-import verify` on a clean migration exits 0 with `discrepancies: 0`.
- [ ] Tampered target: verify exits non-zero with the row ID + column name of the first discrepancy.

- Blocks #140 (audit-log integration runs after a successful import + verify).
